outcome: Accuracy of EFW compared to birth weight
cohort: The study included 153 women with singleton pregnancies who gave birth to live, normal neonates within 15-21 days of the MRI examination, for whom foetal body volume biometry data were available at term.
finding: New models significantly improved the accuracy of foetal weight estimation more than one week before delivery compared to the existing Baker model, with a combination of foetal body volume and MRI-to-delivery interval enabling more accurate EFW determination.
cross-section timing: MRI examinations performed at term, 15-21 days prior to delivery
birth_weight: Used as the reference for EFW; participants gave birth to 'normal neonates' but no specific weight range was mentioned.
